---

## Problem

What happened, what did you expect, and which part of deployment application, credentials and infrastructure is affected?

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest sequence or repository that reproduces it, including relevant commands.

## Environment

Include commit, browser/OS, Docker/Compose versions, redacted configuration and network path.

## Evidence

Include relevant test results and redacted errors. Never include credentials, keys, SDP/candidate
dumps containing private addresses, personal data or user media. Report vulnerabilities through
[private reporting](https://github.com/peerweavejs/peerweave-deployment-example/security/advisories/new).
